question:

GOAL - OLAG-LAOG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/043ab85c606cd06accf636e80d035c63d4458663ec3c2a7b440b26f20040d45b.png]

Option 1) SINK-IKNS-KNIS
